name: Fantasy Recap scoring, the same rules js/rules.js uses
notes: Every value in per is points per one unit of the stat. 0.04 per pass yard is 1 point per 25 yards. 0.1 per rush or receiving yard is 1 point per 10. There is no point per reception: js/rules.js does not give one. A field goal is 3 points, 4 from 40 to 49 yards and 5 from 50 yards (field_goal_bands add to fg_made, the highest band that applies wins). Stat lines do not carry kick distance, so bands only apply when a distance is known. defense_per is for the defense: 1 per sack, 2 per interception caught, 2 per fumble recovered. Defensive touchdowns and points allowed are not scored. The game rounds each play's points to one decimal, so a season total of per-play points can differ from the exact total by a few hundredths.
